GomeBoy 1.1.0 adds durable session recordings, live video streaming, and causal debug tooling for agents and reverse-engineering.

## Session recordings (`.gbrun`)

Record a deterministic run without storing every framebuffer:

- Checked start state, ROM/model identity, input timeline, caller metadata, and a final state hash
- Headless replay verifies the same end state (`ReplayRecording`)
- Video-enabled replay regenerates RGB frames later (`ReplayRecordingFrames`) for screenshots, datasets, or encoding

See [docs/RECORDINGS.md](https://github.com/maestroi/gomeboy/blob/v1.1.0/docs/RECORDINGS.md).

## Streaming and the `gomeboy-stream` binary

This release ships **`gomeboy-stream-linux-amd64`** alongside the desktop emulator. It encodes GomeBoy RGB frames with FFmpeg (H.264) to a file or an RTMP/RTMPS URL.

Live raw frames from another process:

```sh
producer-of-rgb24-frames | ./gomeboy-stream-linux-amd64 -output capture.mp4
```

Replay a recording to video (requires the same ROM):

```sh
./gomeboy-stream-linux-amd64 \
  -rom pokemon-red.gb \
  -recording run.gbrun \
  -output run.mp4
```

Realtime RTMP:

```sh
producer-of-rgb24-frames | ./gomeboy-stream-linux-amd64 \
  -output 'rtmps://example/live/STREAM_KEY' \
  -realtime \
  -bitrate 2500k
```

FFmpeg must be installed and on `PATH` at runtime (or pass `-ffmpeg`). The library also exposes `FrameSink`, `PublishFrame`, `StepFrameTo`, and `StepFramesTo` so a controller can publish from the same emulator instance it is driving.

See [docs/STREAMING.md](https://github.com/maestroi/gomeboy/blob/v1.1.0/docs/STREAMING.md).

## Debug tooling

- **`memprobe`**: checkpoint-and-compare experiments that apply control vs button actions from the same baseline and report byte-level memory diffs. Build with `go build ./cmd/memprobe`. Docs: [docs/MEMPROBE.md](https://github.com/maestroi/gomeboy/blob/v1.1.0/docs/MEMPROBE.md).
- Instruction- and frame-granular `RunUntil` / `RunCPUUntil` watchpoints, `CPUState` / `PPUState`, flight recorder, and the generic introspection APIs remain the core debugger surface.

## Binaries

| Asset | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `gomeboy-linux-amd64` | Desktop GLFW emulator |
| `gomeboy-stream-linux-amd64` | FFmpeg CLI for live RGB encoding and `.gbrun` replay-to-video |
